title: Sinkhorn algorithms for entropic vector quantile regression
summary: Vector quantile regression (VQR) is an optimal transport (OT)-based framework that extends linear quantile regression to vector-valued response variables and can be formulated as an OT problem with a mean-independence constraint. In this paper, we study Sinkhorn-type algorithms for VQR with entropic regularization, building on the authors' previous work on its duality theory.
